definition: to move your arm forward to touch something
description: A woman in a navy headscarf and lilac sleeves stands beside an open built-in oven that glows orange inside; she carries a metal tray of pale dough balls over, stretches her free hand out toward the open oven to feel the heat, then slides the tray onto the rack and closes the door.

en.question: Where is she reaching with her hand?

de.question: Wohin greift sie mit der Hand?

es.answer: Está alargando la mano hacia el horno caliente.

brillar de color naranja por dentro
es.question: ¿Hacia dónde está alargando la mano?

fr.answer: Elle tend la main vers le four chaud.

briller d'une lueur orange à l'intérieur
